learnings.name: cupSeam silently suppressed outside shaping:princess
learnings.evidence: cupSeam:1 + shaping:dart = byte-identical to cupSeam:0 (same pieces, same 8-cmd front bodice). cupSeam:1 + sleeveCap = suppressed (#4). cupSeam:1 on garment:top = no cup piece (#15). Cup panels (Upper/Lower Cup) appear ONLY with dress+princess+cupSeam (#16).
learnings.fix: Honor cupSeam under dart too, or emit an issue when cupSeam is requested but suppressed, so it is never a silent drop.

learnings.name: True wrap / surplice crossover front
learnings.evidence: tieClosure:7 (wrapFront) only adds a tie strip; no crossed-over double front panel. Flat #17 is a classic surplice crossover.

learnings.name: Corset lace-up / eyelet back
learnings.evidence: Both flats show a laced-up back (eyelets + criss-cross / stacked bow-tie cutouts). Engine collapses to a single Back Tie.

learnings.name: All-around / tiered dropped-waist flounce
learnings.evidence: backDetail:flounce is back-only; flats show a flounce/tier running the full circumference at a dropped waist.

learnings.name: Angled / slash pocket
learnings.evidence: pocketStyle offers only patch and sideSeam; flat #8 has an angled slash pocket cut into the front. Likely a cheap vocab-level add (pocket bag geometry exists, only mouth angle differs).

learnings.name: Asymmetric one-shoulder construction
learnings.evidence: Symmetric-draft model cannot represent one-shoulder / diagonal drape. Large lift, not a Round-2 candidate.

notes: Every drafted flat (17) returned error:null and issues:[] - the engine refused nothing and produced no unwearable geometry.
No VALIDATOR FALSE-REJECTIONS found; volume_1 placket-on-top + yoke-facing fixes held (#18).
The WEARABLE/PARTIAL split is about faithfulness to the flat, not wearability.
